flows.name: authentication
assertions: login succeeds with valid tenant-scoped credentials
login fails with invalid credentials
logout invalidates the session without using a browser-native alert
API key access is scoped to the owning customer and project

flows.name: tenant-context
assertions: list operations return only tenant-owned resources
read operations deny resources from another tenant
write operations attach the selected tenant and project
cross-tenant artifact access is denied

flows.name: asset-lifecycle
assertions: project lifecycle preserves ownership
environment lifecycle resolves project-scoped configuration
step lifecycle stores supported Selenium, Appium, Postman, and DSL metadata
test-cycle lifecycle preserves ordered steps and compatibility metadata

flows.name: cycle-launch
assertions: manual launch creates a queued execution
runner handoff uses bounded timeouts
missing dependencies fail with actionable diagnostics
failed required steps interrupt the test and preserve result evidence

flows.name: parallel-execution
assertions: worker metadata is isolated per execution
parallel reports merge deterministically
resource limits prevent unbounded execution growth
stale workers time out with explicit state

flows.name: reporting
assertions: JSON report follows the supported schema
HTML, Markdown, and JUnit exports are generated from the same result contract
reports redact credentials and tenant-sensitive values
artifact descriptors include checksum and authorized retrieval metadata

flows.name: backward-compatibility
assertions: current train accepts the previous compatible fixture
unsupported future schemas fail before execution
legacy behavior changes include a migration guide
release gates record compatibility evidence

gateThresholds.minimumCoveragePolicy: thresholds cannot be lowered without an RFC or release decision record
